module: Owner's circular microphone PCB / INMP441 reported in project
source: Owner-reported physical dimensions in chat; diameter unit explicitly corrected from '14in' to 14 mm. Instrument not restated for this batch.
status: partial physical survey; enough for first-pass board envelope with outstanding solder, port, and notch details

coordinate_reference.view: Viewed face/orientation not stated; 'top' and 'bottom' refer to owner's described alignment with notches at 12 and 6 o'clock. Confirm before finalizing absolute pin numbering.
coordinate_reference.provisional_origin: Circle center at (X=0,Y=0), X right, Y up in owner's described view. This is a modeling convenience, not an owner-established datum.
coordinate_reference.z_reference: 26 mm is owner-reported FULL assembly height from highest header to lowest soldered-wire point, not height of an individual pin or clearance on one face.

pcb.shape: circular with two small notches at top and bottom

diameter_mm.notes: Owner explicitly corrected prior '14in' to 14 mm

notches.positions: top and bottom of circle, diametrically opposite according to description

width_mm.notes: Width of each notch as owner described

inset_depth_mm.notes: Indent inward from outer circular contour

total_pin_count.notes: Owner: '6 header pins run horizontally to the notches'

pins_per_row.notes: Owner confirmed two horizontal rows, three pins in each row, 2026-11-12.

upper_row_width_mm.notes: Owner described top row as 6.2 mm wide; unclear whether outer pin-to-pin span, complete metal pad span or plastic header width

electrical_headers.connection_type: Existing microphone wiring reported as soldered to S3; exact microphone-end connection arrangement unconfirmed

acoustic_port.location: dead center of circular PCB (owner reported)

port_face.notes: Do not assume the acoustic opening is on the same face as any chip or connectors without verifying

height_from_top_of_header_to_lowest_sold.notes: Overall high-to-low installed envelope including pin headers and soldered wire ends. Not enough to split Z extent about PCB; keep as overall bounding dimension.
